afterImage.description: Helix Digital Infrastructure is a KKR-owned platform established to finance, develop, deliver, own, operate, and manage the data centers, power, transmission, fiber, and connectivity required by hyperscale artificial-intelligence customers. The platform launched publicly in June 2026 with more than US$10 billion of long-duration capital commitments and a dedicated leadership team. Helix Digital Infrastructure LLC directly states that it is wholly owned by KKR & Co. Inc. KIA, NVIDIA, and Vistra participate as strategy-level investors or partners rather than direct LLC owners; their interests are not counted as separate company ownership periods.
